label: integer-10000
_comment: The recorded input trace of GC-023's 10,000-step integer fixture: shape, seed and schedules drive both player and EditMode suites; the jobs shape is declared field by field. observationDigest was identical across five passing Linux IL2CPP runs before pinning and is checked by tools/unity/run_replay_probe.sh. supersededObservationDigest records the round-1 12-observation table only.
_hashes: Canonical state, decision, provenance, event and chain hashes are deliberately NOT literals here. The acceptance criterion TEST-022 states is that replays of the same recorded input agree with each other across worker counts, shuffled producer orders and publish permutations; a remembered hash would only assert that the code did not change, which is a weaker claim and a worse one to maintain. The probe and the suites compare two runs of this record, and the runs' hashes are recorded in the probe artifact (artifacts/gc-023/toolchain/probe-replay.json) as the build host's measurement.
